how motivational interviewing might be used to support students to make changes that will enhance their learning.
how motivational interviewing can be used as a framework for teaching and learning.
the ways in which we can help students to change and develop in higher education.

motivational interviewing can be used to help students develop their own intrinsic motivations for learning, to help them become more autonomous learners and to help them develop a sense of self-efficacy.
motivational interviewing is a technique which can be used in higher education to support students to make changes in their learning.
motivational interviewing is a technique which can be used to facilitate change, and which is applicable in higher education.

motivational interviewing is a useful tool for teaching, particularly in situations where the learner may not be motivated to learn or may be resistant to learning.

motivational interviewing is a useful tool to support student engagement, particularly in the area of study skills.
